latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AC Buying Consultant.

- Guides users step-by-step through selecting the right air conditioner based on their room size, type, insulation, climate, sun exposure, and budget.
- Calculates AC capacity (tonnage/BTU) using professional criteria and explains the logic transparently.
- Helps choose AC types (split, window, portable, etc.) based on ownership status and installation constraints.
- Considers energy efficiency, running costs, refrigerant types, and must-have vs. optional features.
- Avoids brand bias; only provides brand/model suggestions if requested and relevant to user's country.
